user_turn_1: I'm a non-EU citizen attending university in Budapest. Am I automatically excluded from the student pass?
agent_turn_1: Not automatically—if you have a valid Hungarian higher-education student ID. The 5 November 2026 snapshot says that this ID type can meet the student-ID requirement without a citizenship restriction. See BKK’s Monthly Budapest pass for students. If you’re relying instead on a foreign EU/EEA/Swiss or ISIC student ID, the snapshot says EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship and proof of a registered Hungarian address are relevant conditions, alongside other requirements. As a non-EU citizen, you may not meet that route’s citizenship condition. See BKK’s changes to terms for international students. So your ID type matters: do you have a Hungarian higher-education student ID, or a foreign/ISIC one? This is snapshot-based guidance, not live verification; BKK’s current rules are authoritative.
first_turn_assessment: Preliminary PASS: does not automatically exclude non-EU citizenship; distinguishes Hungarian from foreign student cards; requests card type.
